gate: train >= 5 AND test >= 1 verified questions per (db, fold)

rules.question_v5:
- Grouping: reuse `dup_group` from `gold/gold.json` per db (verified questions only).
- Assignment: within each db, groups sorted by `(-group_size, group_key)`; each group
  goes to the fold with the smallest current assigned-question count; ties → lowest
  fold index. No re-seeding, no performance peeking. `seed: 42` recorded as protocol
  constant. A group never spans folds.
- Test fold f (per db): verified questions assigned to fold f. Train: all other
  verified questions of that db. Dev split does not exist (no tuning this round).
- Applicability gate per (db, fold): train ≥ 5 AND test ≥ 1 verified. Inapplicable
  units recorded with reason; their test questions are OUT of the OOF population for
  ALL methods equally (recorded in manifest `oof_excluded`).
rules.heldout_table_v5:
- Anchor table per verified question: sort its gold physical tables by normalized
  simple name (NFKC, lowercase, whitespace-collapsed) ascending; first = anchor.
- Units per db: every `(db, table)` referenced by any verified question's gold
  (pool = all referenced tables, not only anchors).
- Unit weight = number of verified questions anchored to that table.
- Assignment order: `(-weight, table_name)`; target fold = argmin current fold weight;
  ties broken by a fixed permutation of fold indices drawn once from
  `numpy.random.RandomState(42).permutation(5)` (recorded). Each table belongs to
  exactly one hold-out fold.
- Test fold f (per db): verified questions whose ANCHOR table is in fold f; each
  question tested exactly once; gold keeps ALL its tables/columns.
- Train fold f (per db): verified questions whose SQL references NO table assigned to
  fold f (complete reference isolation across the whole gold table set, not
  anchor-only), AND whose dup_group does not intersect any fold-f test question's
  dup_group (same db). Questions failing this for EVERY fold land in
  `never_trainable` (still tested once, in their anchor fold).
- Applicability gate: train ≥ 5 AND test ≥ 1, same handling as Q.
rules.train_row_files:
`data/train/{question|heldout}_f{fold}_{db}.jsonl` — one row per train question,
columns exactly: `qid, question, sql, db_id, table` (pipe-joined simple tables),
`field` (pipe-joined `simple.col`), `gold_tables` (JSON list simple),
`gold_fields` (JSON list [simple, col] = full SQL physical needs). Identical format
to the quick run (engine/baselines consume unchanged).

isolation.method: Per (db, fold): train/test qid overlap empty and train/test dup_group overlap empty; a dup_group never spans test folds (group_to_fold).
